items.caption: This seal-script rendering of 零 combines 雨, the rain semantic element, with 令, traditionally identified as the sound element. The Shuowen tradition records this analysis, though another edition reads 霝聲.
items.alt: Black seal-script form of 零 on a white background, with 雨 above and 令 below.
items.selection_reason: It visibly illustrates the received seal-script form and the components discussed in traditional analyses. It is a modern redraw, so it cannot establish the character’s earliest graphic form.

limitations.text: This is a modern digital redraw of a received seal-script form, not an image of an excavated ancient inscription; no verified early inscription form of 零 is established here.
The Shuowen account differs between 令聲 and 霝聲, and the available evidence does not resolve the reason for that difference.
